notes: Behavioral counters for LARA benchmark runs. Each counter measures a signal we tracked manually during the 2026-05-21..22 venmo-5 iteration. Extended during 'manual discovery' phases (when we make a substantial code change or hit a new task family). The autonomous loop reads this config to compute uniform panel deltas in 'automated improvement' phases. Scopes: all_outputs (every ReAct step's output), all_code (every step's code), all_plans (Explorer plans), all_traces (everything concatenated). pattern_type: substring or regex.

counters.name: phone_login_401
counters.description: Phone login 401 errors. Should be 0 after the username-routing fix in executor_helpers.py.

counters.name: search_contacts_relationship
counters.description: Calls to search_contacts with relationship=...  — the desired pattern for group resolution. Matches both call_api(...) and fetch_all_pages(...) wrappers since LARA APIs go through bootstrap helpers.
counters.added_for: Explorer prompt change — concrete group-lookup examples

counters.name: show_contact_relationships_calls
counters.description: Calls to show_contact_relationships. Antipattern — it returns relationship TYPES, not people. Should shrink as search_contacts(relationship=...) takes over.
counters.added_for: Explorer prompt change — group-lookup antipattern tracking

counters.name: get_current_date_and_time
counters.description: Sandbox-clock adoption. Should grow as the two-step date pattern lands in plans.
counters.added_for: Explorer prompt change — TIME-RELATIVE WINDOWS pattern verification

counters.name: datetime_now
counters.description: Wall-clock antipattern. The sandbox clock is not today's date — datetime.now() returns the wrong year.
counters.added_for: Explorer prompt change — wall-clock fallback detection

counters.name: fetch_all_pages
counters.description: Pagination discipline. Tracks how often the executor reaches for fetch_all_pages on listing APIs.

counters.name: premature_complete_task_strips
counters.description: Orchestrator strip-events from the premature-complete_task guard (base.py). Each occurrence is a saved task that would have submitted too early.

counters.name: phone_executor_dispatches
counters.description: Per-step dispatches to PhoneExecutor. Confirms the orchestrator routes phone steps to the right specialist.

counters.name: venmo_executor_dispatches
counters.description: Per-step dispatches to VenmoExecutor. Co-tracked with PhoneExecutor to see how the orchestrator splits cross-app tasks.

counters.name: no_api_named_errors
counters.description: Executor invented an API name that the AppWorld sandbox doesn't recognize. Antipattern; co-occurs with E-EXEC-INVENT-API.
